import unittest
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

import stockroom
from stockroom import ParseError, parse_catalog, parse_movements, parse_orders

CAT = (
    "AB-100 | Garden gnome | 12.50 | 5 | standard\n"
    "cd-205 | Seed packet, mix | 1.99 | 40 | reduced\n"
    "EF-310 | Gift voucher | 25.00 | 0\n"
)


def catalog():
    return parse_catalog(CAT)


class ErrorLine(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertBad(self, func, text, line, *extra):
        with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as ctx:
            func(text, *extra)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.line, line, str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertIn("line %d" % line, str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertIsInstance(ctx.exception, ValueError)


class CatalogTests(ErrorLine):
    def test_parses_products(self):
        cat = catalog()
        self.assertEqual(list(cat), ["AB-100", "CD-205", "EF-310"])
        p = cat["CD-205"]
        self.assertEqual((p.sku, p.name, p.reorder, p.tax), ("CD-205", "Seed packet, mix", 40, "reduced"))
        self.assertEqual(p.price, Decimal("1.99"))
        self.assertIsInstance(p.price, Decimal)
        self.assertEqual(cat["EF-310"].tax, "standard")

    def test_tax_any_case_stored_lower(self):
        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0|ZeRo\nAB-101|x|1|0|REDUCED\n")
        self.assertEqual([p.tax for p in cat.values()], ["zero", "reduced"])

    def test_bad_tax(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|1|0|full\n", 1)

    def test_price_rules(self):
        for ok in ("12", "12.5", "1.99", "0.01", "007.10"):
            parse_catalog("AB-100|x|%s|0\n" % ok)
        for bad in ("12.505", "1,000.00", "-3", "abc", "0", "0.00", ".5", "12.", "", "+1", "１２", "1_0"):
            self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|%s|0\n" % bad, 1)

    def test_reorder_rules(self):
        parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0\n")
        for bad in ("-1", "1.5", "", "x", "+1", "١"):
            self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|1|%s\n" % bad, 1)

    def test_sku_rules(self):
        for ok in ("AB-100", "abcd-999", "aB-000"):
            parse_catalog("%s|x|1|0\n" % ok)
        for bad in ("A-100", "ABCDE-100", "AB-10", "AB-1000", "AB100", "A1-100", "ÄB-100", "AB-١٢٣"):
            self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "%s|x|1|0\n" % bad, 1)

    def test_sku_upper_cased(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(parse_catalog("ab-100|x|1|0\n")), ["AB-100"])

    def test_empty_name(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|  |1|0\n", 1)

    def test_field_count(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|1\n", 1)
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|1|0|standard|extra\n", 1)
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|y|1|0\n", 1)

    def test_duplicate_sku_on_second_line(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "AB-100|x|1|0\nab-100|y|1|0\n", 2)

    def test_whitespace_trimmed_around_fields(self):
        cat = parse_catalog("\t AB-100 \t|\t gnome \t| 1.5 | 2 |\t reduced\t\n")
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].name, "gnome")
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].tax, "reduced")

    def test_name_keeps_inner_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_catalog("AB-100|a  #b\x0c c|1|0\n")["AB-100"].name, "a  #b\x0c c")


class LineHandlingTests(ErrorLine):
    def test_bom_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(parse_catalog("﻿" + CAT)), ["AB-100", "CD-205", "EF-310"])

    def test_bom_only_at_start(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "﻿﻿AB-100|x|1|0\n", 1)

    def test_crlf(self):
        cat = parse_catalog(CAT.replace("\n", "\r\n"))
        self.assertEqual(cat["EF-310"].reorder, 0)
        moves = parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 +1 hi there\r\n", cat)
        self.assertEqual(moves[0].note, "hi there")

    def test_lone_cr_is_content(self):
        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|a\rb|1|0\n")
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].name, "a\rb")
        moves = parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 +1 a\rb\n", cat)
        self.assertEqual(moves[0].note, "a\rb")

    def test_other_line_separators_stay_inside_line(self):
        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|a\x0bb\x0cc\x1cd e\x85f|1|0\n")
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].name, "a\x0bb\x0cc\x1cd e\x85f")
        moves = parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 +1 n\x0cm o\n", cat)
        self.assertEqual(moves[0].note, "n\x0cm o")

    def test_blank_and_comment_lines_ignored(self):
        text = "\n# c\n   \t \n  # indented\nAB-100|x|1|0\n\n"
        self.assertEqual(list(parse_catalog(text)), ["AB-100"])
        self.assertEqual(parse_movements("# only\n\n", catalog()), [])
        self.assertEqual(parse_orders("\t# only\n\n", catalog()), [])

    def test_empty_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_catalog(""), {})

    def test_line_numbers_count_every_physical_line(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "# a\n\n   \nAB-100|x|zz|0\n", 4)
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "# a\r\n\r\nAB-100|x|zz|0\r\n", 3)

    def test_only_spaces_and_tabs_are_whitespace(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "\x0cAB-100|x|1|0\n", 1)
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, " AB-100|x|1|0\n", 1)
        self.assertBad(parse_catalog, "\x0c\n", 1)

    def test_last_line_without_newline(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0")), ["AB-100"])


class MovementTests(ErrorLine):
    def test_parses_movements_in_file_order(self):
        text = (
            "2024-03-05 CD-205 40\n"
            "2024-03-01 AB-100 +20 first delivery\n"
            "2024-03-04 ab-100 -3 order SO-1001\n"
        )
        moves = parse_movements(text, catalog())
        self.assertEqual([m.sku for m in moves], ["CD-205", "AB-100", "AB-100"])
        self.assertEqual(moves[1].date, date(2024, 3, 1))
        self.assertEqual((moves[1].quantity, moves[1].note), (20, "first delivery"))
        self.assertEqual((moves[0].quantity, moves[0].note), (40, ""))
        self.assertEqual(moves[2].quantity, -3)
        self.assertIsInstance(moves[2].quantity, int)

    def test_separators_tabs_and_note_kept_as_written(self):
        moves = parse_movements("2024-03-01 \t AB-100\t+5 \t two  words \t\n", catalog())
        self.assertEqual(moves[0].note, "two  words")

    def test_dates(self):
        for bad in ("2024-02-30", "2023-02-29", "2024-13-01", "2024-1-01", "24-01-01", "2024/01/01", "2024-01-1٠", "0000-01-01"):
            self.assertBad(parse_movements, "%s AB-100 +1\n" % bad, 1, catalog())
        parse_movements("2024-02-29 AB-100 +1\n", catalog())

    def test_sku_must_be_in_catalog(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 ZZ-999 +1\n", 1, catalog())
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 ß-100 +1\n", 1, catalog())

    def test_quantity_rules(self):
        for ok in ("5", "+5", "05"):
            parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 %s\n" % ok, catalog())
        for bad in ("0", "+0", "-0", "1.5", "--1", "+-1", "x", "1_0", "١"):
            self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 AB-100 %s\n" % bad, 1, catalog())

    def test_too_few_fields(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 AB-100\n", 1, catalog())
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01\n", 1, catalog())

    def test_never_below_zero_reports_offending_line(self):
        text = "2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n2024-03-02 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-03 AB-100 -3\n"
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, text, 3, catalog())

    def test_below_zero_in_date_order_not_file_order(self):
        text = "2024-03-05 AB-100 -4\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n2024-03-03 AB-100 -3\n"
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, text, 1, catalog())
        ok = "2024-03-05 AB-100 -4\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n"
        self.assertEqual(len(parse_movements(ok, catalog())), 2)

    def test_same_day_keeps_file_order(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 AB-100 -1\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n", 1, catalog())
        parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n2024-03-01 AB-100 -5\n", catalog())

    def test_products_tracked_separately(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_movements, "2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n2024-03-02 CD-205 -1\n", 2, catalog())


class OrderTests(ErrorLine):
    def test_parses_orders(self):
        text = "SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*12,CD-205*3\nso-1002\t2024-03-09   Bea ab-100*2\n"
        orders = parse_orders(text, catalog())
        self.assertEqual([o.id for o in orders], ["SO-1001", "SO-1002"])
        self.assertEqual(orders[0].date, date(2024, 3, 3))
        self.assertEqual(orders[0].customer, "acme")
        self.assertEqual(orders[0].lines, [("AB-100", 12), ("CD-205", 3)])
        self.assertEqual(orders[1].lines, [("AB-100", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(orders[1].customer, "Bea")

    def test_order_ids_distinct_by_string(self):
        orders = parse_orders("SO-7 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\nSO-007 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n", catalog())
        self.assertEqual([o.id for o in orders], ["SO-7", "SO-007"])

    def test_duplicate_id_any_case(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-7 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\nso-7 2024-01-02 b AB-100*1\n", 2, catalog())

    def test_bad_ids(self):
        for bad in ("SO7", "SO-", "XO-1", "SO-1a", "SO--1", "SO-١"):
            self.assertBad(parse_orders, "%s 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n" % bad, 1, catalog())

    def test_bad_date(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-1 2024-02-30 a AB-100*1\n", 1, catalog())

    def test_field_count(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-1 2024-01-01 a\n", 1, catalog())
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-1 2024-01-01 two words AB-100*1\n", 1, catalog())
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-1 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1,\x20CD-205*1\n", 1, catalog())

    def test_bad_lines(self):
        for bad in (
            "AB-100", "AB-100*", "*3", "AB-100*0", "AB-100*+1", "AB-100*-1", "AB-100*1.5",
            "AB-100*1*2", "AB-100*1,", ",AB-100*1", "AB-100*1,,CD-205*1", "ZZ-999*1",
            "AB-100*1,ab-100*2", "AB-100*x", "AB-100*١",
        ):
            self.assertBad(parse_orders, "SO-1 2024-01-01 a %s\n" % bad, 1, catalog())

    def test_line_number_after_blanks(self):
        self.assertBad(parse_orders, "# x\n\nSO-1 2024-01-01 a ZZ-999*1\n", 3, catalog())


class ParseErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_is_value_error_with_line(self):
        err = ParseError(3, "bad price '12.505'")
        self.assertIsInstance(err, ValueError)
        self.assertEqual(err.line, 3)
        self.assertEqual(str(err), "line 3: bad price '12.505'")

    def test_public_api(self):
        for name in ("parse_catalog", "parse_movements", "parse_orders", "stock_levels", "price_order", "ParseError"):
            self.assertTrue(hasattr(stockroom, name), name)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

import stockroom
from stockroom import parse_catalog, parse_movements, shelves

CAT = parse_catalog(
    "AB-100 | Garden gnome | 12.50 | 5\n"
    "CD-205 | Seed packet, mix | 1.99 | 40 | reduced\n"
    "EF-310 | Gift voucher | 25.00 | 0\n"
    "GH-400 | Spade | 9.00 | 3\n"
)


def moves(text):
    return parse_movements(text, CAT)


class StockLevelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_levels_cover_every_product(self):
        m = moves("2024-03-01 AB-100 +20\n2024-03-04 ab-100 -3\n2024-03-05 CD-205 40\n")
        self.assertEqual(
            stockroom.stock_levels(CAT, m), {"AB-100": 17, "CD-205": 40, "EF-310": 0, "GH-400": 0}
        )

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.stock_levels(CAT, []), {s: 0 for s in CAT})

    def test_status(self):
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(0, 5), "out")
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(0, 0), "out")
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(1, 0), "ok")
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(5, 5), "low")
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(6, 5), "ok")
        self.assertEqual(shelves.status(1, 5), "low")

    def test_stock_rows_sorted_by_sku(self):
        m = moves("2024-03-01 AB-100 +20\n2024-03-05 CD-205 40\n")
        rows = shelves.stock_rows(CAT, m)
        self.assertEqual([r.sku for r in rows], ["AB-100", "CD-205", "EF-310", "GH-400"])
        self.assertEqual([r.status for r in rows], ["ok", "low", "out", "out"])

    def test_buy_quantity(self):
        self.assertEqual(shelves.buy_quantity(0, 0), 1)
        self.assertEqual(shelves.buy_quantity(0, 5), 10)
        self.assertEqual(shelves.buy_quantity(40, 40), 40)
        self.assertEqual(shelves.buy_quantity(3, 3), 3)
        self.assertEqual(shelves.buy_quantity(1, 1), 1)

    def test_low_rows(self):
        m = moves("2024-03-01 AB-100 +20\n2024-03-05 CD-205 40\n2024-03-05 GH-400 +2\n")
        rows = shelves.low_rows(CAT, m)
        self.assertEqual([tuple(r) for r in rows], [("CD-205", 40, 40, 40), ("EF-310", 0, 0, 1), ("GH-400", 2, 3, 4)])

    def test_history_in_counting_order(self):
        m = moves(
            "2024-03-04 AB-100 -3 order SO-1\n"
            "2024-03-01 AB-100 +20 first delivery\n"
            "2024-03-04 CD-205 +1\n"
            "2024-03-04 AB-100 +1\n"
        )
        rows = shelves.history_rows("AB-100", m)
        self.assertEqual(
            [tuple(r) for r in rows],
            [
                ("2024-03-01", "+20", 20, "first delivery"),
                ("2024-03-04", "-3", 17, "order SO-1"),
                ("2024-03-04", "+1", 18, ""),
            ],
        )

    def test_history_of_unmoved_sku_is_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(shelves.history_rows("EF-310", []), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from decimal import Decimal as D

from stockroom import Order, parse_catalog, parse_orders, price_order
from datetime import date

CAT = parse_catalog(
    "AB-100 | Garden gnome | 12.50 | 5 | standard\n"
    "CD-205 | Seed packet | 1.99 | 40 | reduced\n"
    "EF-310 | Voucher | 25.00 | 0 | zero\n"
    "GH-400 | Thing | 0.01 | 0 | standard\n"
    "IJ-500 | Cheap | 0.05 | 0 | standard\n"
    "KL-600 | Third | 33.33 | 0 | standard\n"
    "MN-700 | Hundred | 100.00 | 0 | zero\n"
)


def order(*lines):
    return Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "acme", list(lines))


class PricingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_worked_example(self):
        q = price_order(parse_orders("SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*12,CD-205*3\n", CAT)[0], CAT)
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("148.47"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("0.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.tax, D("28.80"))
        self.assertEqual(q.total, D("177.27"))
        l0, l1 = q.lines
        self.assertEqual((l0.sku, l0.quantity, l0.unit, l0.gross, l0.discount, l0.net),
                         ("AB-100", 12, D("12.50"), D("150.00"), D("-7.50"), D("142.50")))
        self.assertEqual((l1.gross, l1.discount, l1.net), (D("5.97"), D("0.00"), D("5.97")))

    def test_two_decimal_places_everywhere(self):
        q = price_order(order(("EF-310", 1)), CAT)
        for value in (q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total, q.lines[0].gross,
                      q.lines[0].discount, q.lines[0].net, q.lines[0].unit):
            self.assertEqual(value.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
        self.assertFalse(q.order_discount.is_signed())
        self.assertFalse(q.lines[0].discount.is_signed())

    def test_volume_thresholds(self):
        def disc(qty):
            return price_order(order(("MN-700", qty)), CAT).lines[0].discount
        self.assertEqual(disc(9), D("0.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(10), D("-50.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(49), D("-245.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(50), D("-500.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(51), D("-510.00"))

    def test_volume_discount_half_up(self):
        # 10 x 0.05 = 0.50; 5% = 0.025 -> 0.03
        self.assertEqual(price_order(order(("IJ-500", 10)), CAT).lines[0].discount, D("-0.03"))
        # 10 x 0.01 = 0.10; 5% = 0.005 -> 0.01
        q = price_order(order(("GH-400", 10)), CAT)
        self.assertEqual((q.lines[0].discount, q.lines[0].net), (D("-0.01"), D("0.09")))

    def test_order_discount_boundary(self):
        below = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("GH-400", 99)), CAT)  # 400.00 + 0.99
        self.assertEqual(below.order_discount, D("0.00"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5)), CAT)  # exactly 500.00
        self.assertEqual((q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total), (D("500.00"), D("-15.00"), D("0.00"), D("485.00")))
        just_under = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("IJ-500", 1999)), CAT)
        self.assertLess(just_under.subtotal, D("500.00") + D("1000"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("GH-400", 100)), CAT)  # 401.00? no: 400+1
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("0.00"))

    def test_order_discount_just_below_500(self):
        q = price_order(order(("KL-600", 15)), CAT)  # 499.95 gross, 5% off
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("0.00"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("KL-600", 3), ("GH-400", 1)), CAT)  # 400+99.99+0.01 = 500.00
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("500.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.00"))

    def test_order_discount_half_up(self):
        # subtotal 500.50 -> 3% = 15.015 -> 15.02
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5), ("IJ-500", 10)), CAT)
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("500.47"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5), ("GH-400", 50)), CAT)  # 500 + 0.50*0.9 = 0.45
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("500.45"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.01"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5), ("GH-400", 17)), CAT)  # 500.17 -> 15.0051 -> 15.01
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.01"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5), ("GH-400", 50), ("IJ-500", 1)), CAT)  # 500.50 -> 15.015
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("500.50"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.02"))

    def test_allocation_largest_remainder_and_tie_break(self):
        # three equal standard lines of 200.00: subtotal 600, discount 18.00, share 6.00 each, no remainder
        # two equal lines 250.50 / 250.50 -> subtotal 501.00 -> 15.03 -> shares 7.515: floor 7.51, 7.51, 1 penny left
        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|a|250.50|0|standard\nCD-205|b|250.50|0|standard\n")
        q = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("AB-100", 1), ("CD-205", 1)]), cat)
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.03"))
        # earlier line gets the extra penny: taxable 250.50-7.52=242.98, 250.50-7.51=242.99
        # tax = 48.596 -> 48.60 ; 48.598 -> 48.60
        self.assertEqual(q.tax, D("97.20"))
        # swap the rates to expose which line got the penny
        cat2 = parse_catalog("AB-100|a|250.50|0|zero\nCD-205|b|250.50|0|standard\n")
        q2 = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("AB-100", 1), ("CD-205", 1)]), cat2)
        # second line (standard) did not get the extra penny: taxable 242.99 -> 48.598 -> 48.60
        self.assertEqual(q2.tax, D("48.60"))
        q3 = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("CD-205", 1), ("AB-100", 1)]), cat2)
        # now the standard line is first and gets the penny: taxable 242.98 -> 48.596 -> 48.60 (same)
        self.assertEqual(q3.tax, D("48.60"))

    def test_allocation_bigger_remainder_wins(self):
        # nets 100.00, 200.00, 201.00 -> subtotal 501.00, D = 15.03
        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|a|100.00|0|standard\nCD-205|b|200.00|0|standard\nEF-310|c|201.00|0|standard\n")
        q = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("AB-100", 1), ("CD-205", 1), ("EF-310", 1)]), cat)
        # exact shares: 3.0 , 6.0 , 6.03 ... check sum of allocated equals discount via tax
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("501.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.03"))

    "KL-600 | Third | 33.33 | 0 | standard\n"
    "MN-700 | Hundred | 100.00 | 0 | zero\n"
)

    return Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "acme", list(lines))

    def test_worked_example(self):
        q = price_order(parse_orders("SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*12,CD-205*3\n", CAT)[0], CAT)
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, D("148.47"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("0.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.tax, D("28.80"))
        self.assertEqual(q.total, D("177.27"))
        l0, l1 = q.lines
        self.assertEqual((l0.sku, l0.quantity, l0.unit, l0.gross, l0.discount, l0.net),
                         ("AB-100", 12, D("12.50"), D("150.00"), D("-7.50"), D("142.50")))
        self.assertEqual((l1.gross, l1.discount, l1.net), (D("5.97"), D("0.00"), D("5.97")))

        q = price_order(order(("EF-310", 1)), CAT)
        for value in (q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total, q.lines[0].gross,
                      q.lines[0].discount, q.lines[0].net, q.lines[0].unit):
            self.assertEqual(value.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
        self.assertFalse(q.order_discount.is_signed())
        self.assertFalse(q.lines[0].discount.is_signed())

    def test_volume_thresholds(self):
        def disc(qty):
            return price_order(order(("MN-700", qty)), CAT).lines[0].discount
        self.assertEqual(disc(9), D("0.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(10), D("-50.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(49), D("-245.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(50), D("-500.00"))
        self.assertEqual(disc(51), D("-510.00"))

        # 10 x 0.05 = 0.50; 5% = 0.025 -> 0.03
        self.assertEqual(price_order(order(("IJ-500", 10)), CAT).lines[0].discount, D("-0.03"))
        # 10 x 0.01 = 0.10; 5% = 0.005 -> 0.01
        q = price_order(order(("GH-400", 10)), CAT)
        self.assertEqual((q.lines[0].discount, q.lines[0].net), (D("-0.01"), D("0.09")))

        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 5)), CAT)  # exactly 500.00
        self.assertEqual((q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total), (D("500.00"), D("-15.00"), D("0.00"), D("485.00")))
        just_under = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("IJ-500", 1999)), CAT)
        self.assertLess(just_under.subtotal, D("500.00") + D("1000"))
        q = price_order(order(("MN-700", 4), ("GH-400", 100)), CAT)  # 401.00? no: 400+1
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("0.00"))

        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, D("-15.01"))

        cat = parse_catalog("AB-100|a|250.50|0|standard\nCD-205|b|250.50|0|standard\n")

        self.assertEqual(q.tax, D("97.20"))

        q2 = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("AB-100", 1), ("CD-205", 1)]), cat2)
        # second line (standard) did not get the extra penny: taxable 242.99 -> 48.598 -> 48.60
        self.assertEqual(q2.tax, D("48.60"))
        q3 = price_order(Order("SO-1", date(2024, 1, 1), "x", [("CD-205", 1), ("AB-100", 1)]), cat2)

    def test_empty_order(self):

        self.assertEqual((q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total), (D("0.00"),) * 4)

    def put(self, name, content):
        if content is None:
            if os.path.exists(self.path(name)):
                os.remove(self.path(name))
            return
        data = content if isinstance(content, bytes) else content.encode("utf-8")
        with open(self.path(name), "wb") as handle:

    def read(self, name):
        with open(self.path(name), "rb") as handle:

        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=ROOT + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", ""))
        argv = list(args) if cwd else list(args) + ["--dir", self.dir]
        if dir_first and not cwd:

        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom"] + argv,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, cwd=cwd or ROOT,
        )
        return Result(proc)

    def ok(self, *args, **kw):
        r = self.run_cli(*args, **kw)
        self.assertEqual(r.code, 0, r.err)

        before = {n: self.read(n) for n in os.listdir(self.dir)}

class Result:
    def __init__(self, proc):
        self.code = proc.returncode
        self.out = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8")
        self.err = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8")


class CliCase(unittest.TestCase):
    catalog = CATALOG
    movements = MOVEMENTS
    orders = ORDERS

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, True)
        self.put("catalog.txt", self.catalog)
        self.put("movements.txt", self.movements)
        self.put("orders.txt", self.orders)

    def path(self, name):
        return os.path.join(self.dir, name)

    def put(self, name, content):
        if content is None:
            if os.path.exists(self.path(name)):
                os.remove(self.path(name))
            return
        data = content if isinstance(content, bytes) else content.encode("utf-8")
        with open(self.path(name), "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(data)

    def read(self, name):
        with open(self.path(name), "rb") as handle:
            return handle.read()

    def run_cli(self, *args, dir_first=False, cwd=None):
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=ROOT + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", ""))
        argv = list(args) if cwd else list(args) + ["--dir", self.dir]
        if dir_first and not cwd:
            argv = ["--dir", self.dir] + list(args)
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom"] + argv,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, cwd=cwd or ROOT,
        )
        return Result(proc)

    def ok(self, *args, **kw):
        r = self.run_cli(*args, **kw)
        self.assertEqual(r.code, 0, r.err)
        return r.out

    def fail(self, code, *args, **kw):
        before = {n: self.read(n) for n in os.listdir(self.dir)}
        r = self.run_cli(*args, **kw)
        self.assertEqual(r.code, code, r.err)
        self.assertEqual(r.out, "", "stdout must be empty on failure")
        self.assertTrue(r.err.startswith("stockroom: "), r.err)
        after = {n: self.read(n) for n in os.listdir(self.dir)}
        self.assertEqual(before, after, "files must be unchanged")
        return r.err

class Result:
    def __init__(self, proc):
        self.code = proc.returncode
        self.out = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8")
        self.err = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8")


class CliCase(unittest.TestCase):
    catalog = CATALOG
    movements = MOVEMENTS
    orders = ORDERS

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, True)
        self.put("catalog.txt", self.catalog)
        self.put("movements.txt", self.movements)
        self.put("orders.txt", self.orders)

    def path(self, name):
        return os.path.join(self.dir, name)

    def put(self, name, content):
        if content is None:
            if os.path.exists(self.path(name)):
                os.remove(self.path(name))
            return
        data = content if isinstance(content, bytes) else content.encode("utf-8")
        with open(self.path(name), "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(data)

    def read(self, name):
        with open(self.path(name), "rb") as handle:
            return handle.read()

    def run_cli(self, *args, dir_first=False, cwd=None):
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=ROOT + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", ""))
        argv = list(args) if cwd else list(args) + ["--dir", self.dir]
        if dir_first and not cwd:
            argv = ["--dir", self.dir] + list(args)
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom"] + argv,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, cwd=cwd or ROOT,
        )
        return Result(proc)

    def ok(self, *args, **kw):
        r = self.run_cli(*args, **kw)
        self.assertEqual(r.code, 0, r.err)
        return r.out

    def fail(self, code, *args, **kw):
        before = {n: self.read(n) for n in os.listdir(self.dir)}
        r = self.run_cli(*args, **kw)
        self.assertEqual(r.code, code, r.err)
        self.assertEqual(r.out, "", "stdout must be empty on failure")
        self.assertTrue(r.err.startswith("stockroom: "), r.err)
        after = {n: self.read(n) for n in os.listdir(self.dir)}
        self.assertEqual(before, after, "files must be unchanged")
        return r.err

class ReadingTests(CliCase):
    def test_missing_catalog_exit_2_for_every_command(self):
        self.put("catalog.txt", None)
        for args in (("stock",), ("low",), ("history", "AB-100"), ("receive", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "1"),
                     ("ship", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "1"), ("quote", "SO-1001"),
                     ("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-10"), ("invoice", "SO-1001"), ("report",)):
            err = self.fail(2, *args)
            self.assertIn("catalog.txt", err)

    def test_missing_dir_exit_2(self):
        r = self.run_cli("stock", "--dir", os.path.join(self.dir, "nope"))
        self.assertEqual((r.code, r.out), (2, ""))

    def test_dir_without_catalog_exit_2(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("stock", "--dir", self.dir + os.sep + "movements.txt").code, 2)

    def test_non_utf8_exit_2(self):
        self.put("catalog.txt", b"AB-100 | Gn\xf6me | 1 | 0\n")
        self.assertIn("catalog.txt", self.fail(2, "stock"))

    def test_directory_instead_of_file_exit_2(self):
        os.remove(self.path("movements.txt"))
        os.mkdir(self.path("movements.txt"))
        r = self.run_cli("stock")
        self.assertEqual((r.code, r.out), (2, ""))
        self.assertIn("movements.txt", r.err)

    def test_missing_movements_and_orders_are_empty(self):
        self.put("movements.txt", None)
        self.put("orders.txt", None)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("stock").splitlines()[0], "AB-100 0 out Garden gnome")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("report"), "")
        self.fail(1, "quote", "SO-1001")

    def test_bom_and_crlf_files(self):
        for name in ("catalog.txt", "movements.txt", "orders.txt"):
            data = self.read(name).decode().replace("\n", "\r\n")
            self.put(name, b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + data.encode())

        self.assertIn("SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme", self.ok("quote", "SO-1001"))

        self.put("catalog.txt", "# c\n\nAB-100 | x | 12.505 | 0\n")

        self.assertIn("movements.txt: line 3", err)

    def test_orders_mistake_names_file_and_line(self):

        self.assertIn("orders.txt: line 1", self.fail(1, "quote", "SO-1"))

    def test_each_command_reads_only_its_files(self):
        self.put("orders.txt", "garbage\n")
        for args in (("stock",), ("low",), ("history", "AB-100"), ("ship", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "1")):
            self.assertEqual(self.run_cli(*args).code, 0, args)
        self.put("orders.txt", ORDERS)
        self.put("movements.txt", "garbage\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("quote", "SO-1001").code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("stock").code, 1)
        for args in (("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-10"), ("invoice", "SO-1001"), ("report",)):
            self.assertEqual(self.run_cli(*args).code, 1, args)

        self.put("orders.txt", b"\xff")

        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("quote", "SO-1001").code, 2)

        self.assertIn("AB-100 17 ok", self.ok("stock", cwd=self.dir))


class OrdersTests(CliCase):
    QUOTE = (
        "SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme\n"
        "AB-100 12 12.50 150.00 -7.50 142.50\n"
        "CD-205 3 1.99 5.97 0.00 5.97\n"
        "subtotal 148.47\n"
        "order discount 0.00\n"
        "tax 28.80\n"
        "total 177.27\n"
    )

    def test_quote_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("quote", "SO-1001"), self.QUOTE)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("quote", "so-1001"), self.QUOTE)

    def test_quote_json(self):
        data = json.loads(self.ok("quote", "SO-1001", "--json"))
        self.assertEqual(list(data), ["order", "date", "customer", "lines", "subtotal", "order_discount", "tax", "total"])
        self.assertEqual(data["lines"][0],
                         {"sku": "AB-100", "quantity": 12, "unit": "12.50", "gross": "150.00", "discount": "-7.50", "net": "142.50"})
        self.assertEqual((data["subtotal"], data["order_discount"], data["tax"], data["total"]),
                         ("148.47", "0.00", "28.80", "177.27"))
        self.assertEqual((data["order"], data["date"], data["customer"]), ("SO-1001", "2024-03-03", "acme"))

    def test_quote_with_order_discount_shows_minus(self):
        self.put("orders.txt", "SO-5 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*50,EF-310*1\n")
        out = self.ok("quote", "SO-5")
        self.assertIn("order discount -", out)
        self.assertIn("AB-100 50 12.50 625.00 -62.50 562.50\n", out)

    def test_quote_unknown_order_refused(self):
        self.assertIn("SO-9", self.fail(1, "quote", "SO-9"))

    def test_fulfil_ships_what_stock_allows(self):

            self.read("movements.txt"),

        )

    def test_fulfil_partial_then_complete(self):

            self.ok("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-03"),

            self.ok("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-05"),
            "AB-100 shipped 7 backordered 0\nCD-205 shipped 0 backordered 0\nstatus complete\n",
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-06").splitlines()[-1], "status complete")

    def invoiced(self):

    def test_invoice_prices_shipped_quantities_only(self):

        self.ok("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-03")

        self.assertIn("AB-100 5 12.50 62.50 0.00 62.50\n", out)

        self.assertNotIn("CD-205", self.ok("invoice", "SO-1001"))

        self.assertIn("SO-1002", self.fail(1, "invoice", "SO-1002"))
        self.fail(1, "invoice", "SO-404")

    def test_report_text_csv_json(self):
        self.ok("fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-03-06")

        self.assertEqual(rows[1]["quoted"], "25.00")
        self.assertEqual(rows[1]["invoiced"], "0.00")

        self.put("movements.txt", "2024-03-01 AB-100 +20\n2024-03-01 CD-205 +3\n2024-03-04 AB-100 -12 order SO-1001\n")
        self.assertTrue(self.ok("report").startswith("SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme partial 12/15 177.27 "))

        self.fail(2, "--json", "stock")

    def test_dir_missing_value(self):
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "stock", "--dir"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=ROOT)
        self.assertEqual((r.returncode, r.stdout), (2, b""))

    def test_dir_anywhere_both_spellings(self):
        expected = self.ok("stock")
        for argv in (["--dir", self.dir, "stock"], ["stock", "--dir=" + self.dir],
                     ["--dir=" + self.dir, "stock", "--json"], ["history", "--dir", self.dir, "AB-100"],
                     ["quote", "--json", "SO-1001", "--dir", self.dir]):
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom"] + argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                               stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=ROOT)
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "--dir=" + self.dir, "stock"],
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(r.stdout.decode(), expected)

    def test_dir_works_for_typed_commands(self):
        r = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "--dir", self.dir, "receive", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "1", "n"],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        r = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "ship", "2024-03-11", "AB-100", "1", "--dir=" + self.dir],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)

    def test_broken_pipe_exits_zero_quietly(self):
        big = "".join("AB-%03d | Product number %d | 1.00 | 0\n" % (i, i) for i in range(1000))
        self.put("catalog.txt", big)
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=ROOT)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "stock", "--dir", self.dir],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, cwd=ROOT,
        )
        proc.stdout.readline()
        proc.stdout.close()
        err = proc.stderr.read()
        self.assertEqual(proc.wait(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(err, b"")

    def test_in_process_main_returns_code(self):
        import contextlib
        import io

        from stockroom.cli import main

        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            self.assertEqual(main(["stock", "--dir", self.dir]), 0)
        self.assertIn("AB-100 17 ok", out.getvalue())
        err = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            self.assertEqual(main(["nope"]), 2)
        self.assertIn("unknown command", err.getvalue())

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# stockroom

Reads three plain-text files — what you sell, what moved on and off the shelves, and what customers
ordered — and answers: what is on the shelves and what needs buying, what an order costs, and what you can
ship today. Python 3.9 or newer, standard library only.

## Install

```
pip install .
```

This installs the importable `stockroom` package and the `stockroom` command (also `python -m stockroom`).

## The files

They live in one folder: the current folder, or the one given with `--dir`. UTF-8, an optional BOM, lines end
at LF or CRLF. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored; line numbers in error messages count them.

`catalog.txt` — `SKU | name | price | reorder | tax` (tax is `standard`, `reduced` or `zero`; optional, default
`standard`):

```
AB-100 | Garden gnome     | 12.50 | 5 | standard
cd-205 | Seed packet, mix | 1.99  | 40 | reduced
EF-310 | Gift voucher     | 25.00 | 0
```

`movements.txt` — `DATE SKU QUANTITY [NOTE]`; stock may never go below zero in date order (same-day lines keep
file order):

```
2024-03-01 AB-100 +20 first delivery
2024-03-04 ab-100 -3 order SO-1001
```

`orders.txt` — `ORDER DATE CUSTOMER SKU*QTY,SKU*QTY`:

```
SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*12,CD-205*3
```

A missing `catalog.txt` is an error; a missing `movements.txt` or `orders.txt` is empty. Each command reads only
the files it needs: `stock`, `low`, `history`, `receive`, `ship` read catalogue + movements; `quote` reads
catalogue + orders; `fulfil`, `invoice`, `report` read all three.

## Commands

```
stockroom stock [--json]                  SKU ONHAND STATUS NAME  (ok / low / out)
stockroom low [--json]                    SKU ONHAND REORDER BUY  (BUY = max(1, 2*reorder - onhand))
stockroom history SKU [--json]            DATE DELTA BALANCE NOTE
stockroom receive DATE SKU QUANTITY [NOTE]   append a stock-in movement
stockroom ship DATE SKU QUANTITY [NOTE]      append a stock-out movement
stockroom quote ORDER [--json]            price an order
stockroom fulfil ORDER DATE               ship what the shelves can cover
stockroom invoice ORDER [--json]          price what has shipped
stockroom report [--format text|csv|json] one row per order
```

`--dir DIR` (or `--dir=DIR`) is accepted anywhere on the line. `receive`, `ship` and `fulfil` take no other
option: every other argument is taken as typed, so `-5` is a bad quantity and `-x` is a valid note.

```
$ stockroom quote SO-1001
SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme
AB-100 12 12.50 150.00 -7.50 142.50
CD-205 3 1.99 5.97 0.00 5.97
subtotal 148.47
order discount 0.00
tax 28.80
total 177.27
```

Prices are exact to the penny, halves round up: 5 % off a line at 10 units, 10 % at 50; a further 3 % off the
whole order at £500.00 or more, shared over the lines (largest remainder, earlier line on ties) before tax.

### Exit status

- `0` it worked (a closed pipe such as `stockroom stock | head -1` also exits `0`);
- `1` a data file has a mistake, or the request is refused (unknown SKU or order, a movement that would take
  stock below zero, nothing shipped for an invoice) — stderr names the file and line, stdout is empty;
- `2` a file cannot be read (missing `catalog.txt`, missing `--dir` folder, not UTF-8) or the command line is
  wrong.

## Library

```python
import stockroom

catalog = stockroom.parse_catalog(open("catalog.txt", encoding="utf-8").read())
```
